WITH event_counts AS (
  SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count
  FROM attendance
  GROUP BY link_to_event
), totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(attendance_count) AS total_count
  FROM event_counts
)
SELECT event_counts.event_id,
       event_counts.attendance_count,
       1.0 * event_counts.attendance_count / totals.total_count AS share
FROM event_counts
CROSS JOIN totals
ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
